title: upstream crosslink: kickoff dry-run leaves worktree and driver records cleanup does not reclaim
description: Upstream finding for dollspace-gay/crosslink, 2026-07-20, from mdatron's kickoff live fire. --dry-run registers a worktree + driver record that kickoff cleanup does not treat as stale — dry runs accumulate live-looking state. Proposal: dry-run records marked as such and reclaimed by cleanup. Companion absorption proposal: kickoff --issue embeds the issue display ID in the generated branch name (currently only session-id + ref + slug; issue linkage lives only in session/lock records).
